name: Royal Park Hotel
accessSummary: Suitengumae Station (Hanzomon Line) Exit 4: directly connected / Ningyocho Station (Hibiya Line) Exit A2: about 5 min walk / Ningyocho Station (Toei Asakusa Line) Exit A3: about 8 min walk

rooms.name: 3F Royal Hall - Full span
rooms.note: The official description gives 600 for a formal dinner, 1,000 for a buffet and 1,200 for theater. On the same official website, the Farewell Ceremony (お別れの会) page states that Royal Hall has a 6 m ceiling and can hold 2,000 people. The room can be divided.

rooms.name: 5F Meeting Room
rooms.note: Screen permanently installed. Visitors: 8:00-22:00, 44,000 yen for 2 hours (extension 22,000 yen per hour). Hotel guests: 0:00-24:00, 33,000 yen for 2 hours (extension 16,500 yen per hour). Tax included.

ops.loadingHours: The venue usage time includes the period from setup to teardown and is the time agreed in advance with hotel staff. If it is exceeded, the prescribed extension fee applies (extension may not be possible depending on the start time of the next event in the venue). For load-in and load-out of decoration and staging materials and equipment by vendors that the organizer has directly engaged with the hotel's consent, the hotel instructs the vendors to follow certain rules that take into account the hotel's appearance and traffic flow. If load-in or load-out runs late into the night and requires hotel staff to be present, a separate attendance fee may be charged. For venue decoration, flowers, audio, lighting, entertainment, companions and gifts, the hotel's designated vendors are used; if a non-designated vendor is used, the hotel's prior approval is required. (Source: Terms for Banquets and Events, PDF created February 2017)
ops.parking: The hotel parking lot has 176 spaces and a height limit of 2.3 m. The regular rate is 300 yen (tax included) per 30 minutes. Guests attending a banquet get 3 hours free, wedding receptions get 5 hours free, hotel guests pay 2,000 yen per car per night, and restaurant users get 2 hours free with spending of 3,000 yen or more. After the privilege time, the regular rate applies. Only when the hotel parking lot is full, the parking lot of the adjacent Tokyo City Air Terminal can also be used. The parking lot has no EV charging facilities.
ops.waitingRooms: The 3F Rose Room is introduced as a banquet room that can be used as a waiting room for VIPs and guests. Royal Hall can be provided with an adjacent waiting room (Farewell Ceremony page). On the 4F there are men's and women's changing rooms, and cloakrooms for storing baggage are on each banquet floor (2F, 3F, 4F) (Banquets and Meetings FAQ).
ops.restaurants: The official restaurant & bar list shows 8 restaurants and bars. On the 1F: Chef's Dining SYMPHONY, Lobby Lounge FONTAINE and Sweets & Bakery IKI. On the 5F: Japanese Restaurant GENJIKOH (private rooms available). On the B1F: Chinese Restaurant KEI-KA-EN (private rooms available), Sushi Restaurant YANONE SUSHI (private rooms available) and Main Bar ROYAL SCOTS (private rooms available). On the 20F: Teppan-yaki SUMIDA (private rooms available). Private rooms: SUMIDA has 2 rooms (4 to 8 people); GENJIKOH has 2 Western-style private rooms (4 to 18 people, or 19 to 40 people when both rooms are used) and 3 Japanese-style private rooms (4 to 8 people); KEI-KA-EN has rooms for 2 to 40 people. For receptions, the "Seminars & Receptions" page under Banquets and Meetings says that various seminars and receptions can be accommodated, and there is the Banquet Hall Party Plan 2026 (30 to 120 people, standing or seated, with free-flow drinks, 15,000 to 25,000 yen per person, April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027; basic usage is a 2-hour slot between 11:00 and 21:00).
